R2 an "or" count of the same food is a second amount keeping the "or", 5 rows, superseding decision 5's blanket refusal. R3 an amount marked per person is the amount and is never scaled with the servings, 3 rows. R4 "(plus <amount> <another food>)" becomes its own row under the line, 2 rows. R5 a substitution carrying its own amount moves to the row's note column, 16 rows. R6 a row that is only a remark, directly under an ingredient heading, becomes a recipe note titled with that heading, 1 row.
